name: PR-list findings badge hover reveals a scoped findings popover
description: On the seeded PR list, hovering PR #482's Findings badge opens the FindingsPopover. The popover is scoped to the PR's latest review (not every review aggregated), so its header count must equal the badge: seed gives PR #482 one review with 2 findings (1 CRITICAL + 1 WARNING), so the header reads '2 FINDINGS' and the CRITICAL finding ('Hardcoded Stripe secret key in commit', sorted first) is listed. This is the real-browser guard for the 'badge says 4, popover says 11' consistency bug — the latest-vs-aggregate distinction itself is pinned by the server integration test (reviews.badge.it.test.ts), since seeded data has only one review per PR. Read-only seeded data (no model call). Assumes a freshly-seeded DB where acme/payments-api (PR #482) is the first repo — guaranteed by e2e-web.yml; run locally via the hermetic stack (see e2e/README.md).
